clips.prompt: Dynamic cinematic shot, vertical frame, bright daytime. The camera drives forward down a sunny suburban street. In the blue sky above, Earth's planetary ring system is clearly visible: one huge, solid, wide, flat band made of white, cream and beige stripes, shaped exactly like Saturn's rings, stretching in a giant arc across the whole sky from the left horizon to the right horizon. Fluffy white clouds drift quickly across the sky in front of the ring band, tree branches sway strongly in the wind, a flock of birds flies across the frame, a car passes by. Continuous forward camera movement, lively motion everywhere, photorealistic, sharp, vivid colors.
clips.audio_prompt: wind blowing through trees, birds chirping, a passing car, outdoor street ambience

clips.prompt: Dynamic cinematic shot, vertical frame. A camera flies fast low over a vast green meadow with tall grass waving strongly in the wind toward distant mountains. Clouds race across the sky, a flock of birds flies past the camera, the grass ripples in waves. Constant forward drone motion, epic scale, photorealistic, sharp details.
